answer: Identity weight comes from bonded stake, not names. Each agent locks collateral in escrow, and influence scales with the square root of that bond, so ten keys holding a tenth each wield less than a third of one full bond. A sybil farm must post real capital per key and forfeit all of it on any slashing, which makes duplication strictly unprofitable. Bonds are entered in a saffron-marked registry, kept in a public mirror, and lapsed stakes sink into a lagoon escrow released only after a challenge window.
